**Texere – The Researcher's Vault 0.5.7** · 18 November 2026

The ready-made Obsidian vault: download **Texere-vault-0.5.7.zip** below, unzip it and open the folder in Obsidian (**Open folder as vault**, then **Trust author and enable plugins**).

- **Texere 0.5.7** inside, with everything since 0.4.24.
- **You choose where highlights go.** The first time you highlight in a PDF, you pick which of the notes it is attached to gets the passages, or none. They are saved there in the background, without opening the note, and you change the choice from the PDF's bottom bar.
- **Underline or highlight.** **Alt + 1…8** picks a colour, **Alt + U** underlines instead of highlighting, in a PDF and in a note, where the same keys colour the selected text. **Ctrl/Cmd + U** is the plain underline.
- **Harder PDFs are annotated exactly.** In printed books with joined letters, or where the hidden text doesn't sit on the letters you see, Texere recognises the page and puts the highlight or underline exactly on the words you selected.
- **Locked PDFs** from publishers are unlocked so you can highlight in them, without damaging them, and when a highlight can't be written, the message says why and what to do.
- **A shorter Help**, written like the tutorial, with a short clip for each step and all the shortcuts in one table. **Edit mode** has its own clip.
- **Insights:** names without a note show where they are used, and words at the start of a sentence are no longer taken for names.
- **Romanian:** „seif” instead of „vault” everywhere.
- The templates and writing guides are the latest ones, and PDF++ takes your name as the author of your annotations during the setup.

The plugin's code and releases: [gorgmihai92/texere-plugin](https://github.com/gorgmihai92/texere-plugin).
